releases.title: Crystalline
releases.description: A song about magical crystals stabbing the heart of the first men.  Thus the first White Walkers were created.

releases.title: Gentle Notion Le Premier
releases.description: A melody of love.  No words but the music should speak it. Float away on a gentle sea of tranquility.

releases.title: Gentle Notion Part Deux
releases.description: A soothing blend of ambient sounds and gentle melodies, designed to evoke a sense of calm and introspection. Close your eyes, take a deep breath, and let the music carry you away to a place of peace and tranquility. Rising from this a crecendo of emotional intensity carries you away and assures you that all is well here. We have arrived at the apex of joy.

releases.title: Driftwood
releases.description: I'm driftwood.  I'm not going to fight it.  Floating down that river without a care. Shaped by time and flow. A since of longing for the expanse.

releases.title: Descent
releases.description: Imagine decending into a dystopian megatropolis.  As you decend into the fog belowyou realize this is the home you didn't choose among the damned and the blessed. Lights of all the shades of heaven shine among this hellish city of mans own making.How many murders will there be tonight?  How many lovers will embrace.  Do you love this city or do you hate it?  Maybe it's both and maybe that is ok.

releases.title: The Mad Man
releases.description: The madman.  A tortured soul of ill repute.  Alone in a dark room.  The demons in his soul encroaching.  He struggles to keep them at bay but knows that eventually they will win.  Nods to Danny Elfman who happens to be my favorite composer

releases.title: Blue Zen
releases.description: zen like chimes blues guitar and hiphop beats in a blender, why?  I have no idea but it works!

releases.title: Quasar
releases.description: Progressive House with elements of Trance and Tech, radiating energy like a quasar - one of the universe's most luminous objects powered by supermassive black holes. Just as quasars can outshine entire galaxies while being billions of light-years away, this track channels cosmic intensity through pulsing rhythms and stellar melodies.

releases.title: Arrival on Ganymede
releases.description: Progressive House track with a spacey vibe

releases.title: Contemplate
releases.description: Strange meditative pop with self made vocal chanting.

releases.title: Hitch Crack Pot
releases.description: Dark and groovy trip-hop track.  Think Massive Attack meets Portishead.

releases.title: Dogs in the Street
releases.description: Down-tempo, jazzy, political, trip-hop track. Think Thievery Corporation meets DJ Shadow.
